property_summary: When transfer does not revert, it must return true; the bug returns false, violating the invariant that a non-reverting transfer always returns true.
When the low-level call to the external token contract succeeds for every address in the array and the transfer function does not revert, the function must return true; the bug always returns false.
For any input where transfer does not revert, the return value must be true; the mutant always returns false even when all internal calls succeed.
For any non-empty _tos array, transfer must revert if any low-level transferFrom call fails; the bug returns true even on failure.
